company.name: Prism
company.description: Prism (Design Prism, design-prism.com) is a marketing agency for small businesses with four services: website design, content, ads, and AEO (answer engine optimization). One team plans, builds, and improves the work so customers can find, trust, and choose the business on Google and in AI answers.
company.availability: Prism is at capacity. New work starts in monthly intakes: join the waitlist, Prism reviews applications, and reaches out by email to the teams it can take on. Booking a call is not a public action.
company.disambiguation: The marketing agency at design-prism.com, founded by Enzo Sison in 2023.

prefill.description: Link to the form with non-personal answers already filled in. The person still reviews every step, types their own name and email, and submits it themselves.

query_params.focus: Comma-separated services: aeo, website, content, ads.
query_params.website: The business's public website (a domain or an http(s) URL, up to 200 characters).

prefill.not_accepted: Names, email, phone, and goals are never read from the URL, so personal details stay out of links.

waitlist_form.how_to_submit: Fill the form on the page in a browser, one step at a time, and submit only with the user's authorization. A filled form is not a received application: only the /waitlist/thank-you confirmation page confirms it was accepted. There is no public API for applications.
